meta.title: Image Compressor - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Compress images to reduce file size while maintaining quality. Free and private.
formatAutoDetected: Format is auto-detected — no need to select manually
anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.
tooManyConversions: Too many conversions. Please wait a moment.
dragCornersToCrop: Drag corners or region to crop
jpegHighQualityWarning: High quality on compressed JPEG may increase file size.
steps_compress-image_1Desc: Select one or more images to compress. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC. All processing stays on your device.
steps_compress-image_2Desc: Adjust the quality percentage — lower numbers mean smaller files but more visible compression. Find the sweet spot between size and quality for your use case.
steps_compress-image_3Desc: Click Compress to reduce file sizes. Compare original vs compressed sizes shown after processing. Download individually or as a batch.
desc: Compress images to reduce file size while maintaining quality. Free and private.
